derivation: Foundation 50 Audio.RendererDetail, read from the pinned Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Xact.dll. It is `.class public sequential ansi sealed beforefieldinit` extending System.ValueType over two private string fields, _name and _id, and declares seven identities plus one `assembly` constructor that stores the two arguments with no validation. get_FriendlyName and get_RendererId are one ldfld each. op_Equality compares _name with String::op_Equality and, only if that holds, compares _id the same way; op_Inequality is its negation. Equals(object) returns false for null, returns false when GetType differs, and otherwise delegates to op_Equality. GetHashCode is (String.IsNullOrEmpty(_name) ? 0 : _name.GetHashCode()) ^ (String.IsNullOrEmpty(_id) ? 0 : _id.GetHashCode()), with the name's contribution as the left operand. ToString is declared and its whole body is a call to ValueType::ToString, which answers the type's own fully-qualified CLR name. Not one of the seven reaches a device, an engine or a native entry point: the type's frontier deferral was about its producer, an XACT AudioEngine, and not about the type.
